headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 11, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 13 batters and allowing just 2 hits. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed C Will Smith on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 8, 2026, due to neck inflammation. The Texas Rangers placed LHP Jalen Beeks on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 10, 2026, with low back spasms. The Pittsburgh Pirates placed CF Oneil Cruz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 8, 2026, with left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures.

The Philadelphia Phillies acquired RF Derek Hill and Other Considerations from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. The Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers. The Seattle Mariners acquired RHP Carson Fulmer from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Houston Astros acquired 2B Raynel Delgado from the Tampa Bay Rays for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 13 batters and allowing just 2 hits. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Angel Martínez led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Giants Edge Nationals in Thrilling 11-10 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a hard-fought 11-10 victory over the Washington Nationals, coming out on top in a back-and-forth contest. Matt Chapman led the Giants' offense with a standout performance, going 4-for-5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Fernando Tatis Jr. leading the charge at the plate. Tatis Jr. hit two home runs, including a key line drive to left field, and drove in two runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Mets Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 in a closely contested game. Christian Scott was a standout on the mound for the Mets, while Alec Burleson and Lars Nootbaar had notable performances for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 11-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins in a lopsided 11-0 victory, with several players contributing to the team's high-scoring performance. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Riley Greene, Spencer Torkelson, and Zach McKinstry.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Will Smith Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to neck inflammation, with the move retroactive to June 8, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Acquire Outfield Depth in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have bolstered their outfield with the addition of CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares, acquired in a trade with the Chicago White Sox.
